module_purpose: Define the IPD-12 (Intransitive Prime-Numbered 12-Sided Engine) as a first-class framework artifact and agentic operator system within TriadicFrameworks, providing a physicalizable operator engine that encodes intransitive, prime-indexed cycles compatible with RTT, GU, FFT, and Pantheon structures, and specifying the agent classes, probe envelope, and output contract required to operate it.
module_summary: IPD-12 is a 12-faced, prime-indexed, intransitive operator engine that serves as the structural backbone of the TriadicFrameworks vST Micro-Agent. Each face corresponds to a prime-labeled operator state (P2–P37); directed intransitive relations between faces form four triad cycles, two hex-cycles, and one full paradox loop. The engine is operated by four agent classes (Envelope Interrogator, Structural Operator, Integration Coordinator, Coherence Guardian) against a 12-probe structural envelope. This module formalizes IPD-12 as a framework object, enabling RTT resonance-first interpretations, GU geometric embeddings, FFT field-theoretic cycle analysis, and Pantheon-tier mappings, and provides a complete 4×4×4 substrate cube (64 primitives) as its dimensional foundation.

apex_operators.ipd_face_prime: Represents a prime-indexed operator state on one of the 12 faces.
apex_operators.ipd_intransitive_edge: Directed relation between two faces forming non-transitive cycles.
apex_operators.ipd_cycle: Closed intransitive loop over a subset of faces (triad, hex, or full paradox loop).
apex_operators.ipd_regime_transition: Mapping of IPD cycles to RTT regime transitions.
apex_operators.ipd_coherence_stabilizer: Use of prime gaps and cycle structure as coherence stabilizers.
apex_operators.ipd_envelope_interrogator: Class A agent operator: resolves all 12 probe fields sequentially before any structural operator runs.
apex_operators.ipd_structural_operator: Class B agent operator: executes pattern, periodicity, local_symmetry, or transition_topology operators against a normalized stream guided by the filled envelope.
apex_operators.ipd_integration_coordinator: Class C agent operator: consolidates multi-operator results, enforces the output contract, and routes completed interpretations to storage.
apex_operators.ipd_coherence_guardian: Class D agent operator: monitors sessions for drift, invariant violations, and semantic inference contamination; issues WARN, HALT, or RESET signals.

structure_descriptors.indexing_scheme: Prime-numbered labels assigned to operator states; the first 12 primes map to 12 canonical positions.
structure_descriptors.cycle_behavior: Non-transitive cycles that model paradox and regime transitions; three nested levels: 4 triads, 2 hex-cycles, 1 full paradox loop.
structure_descriptors.physicalizable: Specified as a dodecahedral die with one prime face per side; see physical_layout.md.
structure_descriptors.substrate_cube: 4×4×4 dimensional model: 4 substrate pairs × 4 observer modes × 4 regime shells = 64 substrate primitives.
structure_descriptors.probe_envelope: 12 orthogonal probe fields (intent, regime, scale, transition, boundary, invariants, modifiers, substrate, lineage, failure_mode, time_regime, symmetry) that must all be resolved before any operator runs.

resonance_descriptors.rtt_mapping: IPD cycles interpreted as RTT paradox and regime operators over resonance fields.
resonance_descriptors.coherence_use: Prime gaps and cycle stability used as coherence indicators; P11 and P31 are dedicated coherence-node operators.
resonance_descriptors.drift_interpretation: Slow changes in cycle structure treated as drift; P5 and P29 are drift-anchor operators; drift is on-by-default and must be explicitly bounded.
resonance_descriptors.dimensional_hooks: 12-fold structure compatible with TriadicFrameworks canonical twelve-layer architectures; P23 activates +1D lift, P29 activates −1D collapse.

observer_model.triadic_view: Observer interacts with IPD-12 via choice (field / O1), cycle recognition (regime / O2), and stability assessment (coherence / O3).
observer_model.apex_view: O4 (Apex) observer queries dimensional effects through P23, P29, and P37 at the +1D high-order level.
observer_model.pantheon_view: Faces and cycles mapped to Celestial (P2–P7), Civilizational (P11–P19), and Chthonic (P23–P37) tiers.
observer_model.gu_view: IPD cycles embedded as geometric states in GU-compatible interpretations: Connection (P2, P3), Curvature (P7, P11), Dilaton (P11, P31), Anomaly (P13, P37), Observerse (P17, P19, P23).
observer_model.fft_view: Triad crossings = regime transitions; hex-cycle completions = boundary events; full paradox loop = dimensional gate; intransitive edges = closed flux loop topology.

paradox_and_cycles.paradox_summary: Intransitive relations between faces generate paradox loops analogous to RTT paradox operators. Paradox is a structural condition, not an error; it is held open as a stable cycle rather than forced to collapse.
paradox_and_cycles.cycle_summary: Directed cycles over prime-indexed faces provide a combinatorial model of regime transitions and paradox resolution. Three nested levels: 4 triad cycles (3 nodes each), 2 hex-cycles (6 nodes each), 1 full paradox loop (12 nodes).

agent_model.summary: Four agent classes govern all IPD-12 operations. No operator may run without a fully resolved envelope from Class A. Class D has unconditional interrupt authority over all other classes.
agent_model.class_a: Envelope Interrogator — fills all 12 probe fields sequentially; no partial envelope may pass downstream.
agent_model.class_b: Structural Operator — executes selected operators (pattern, periodicity, local_symmetry, transition_topology) against the normalized stream.
agent_model.class_c: Integration Coordinator — consolidates multi-operator results, validates against schema, enforces output contract, routes to storage.
agent_model.class_d: Coherence Guardian — monitors for drift, invariant violations, semantic inference contamination; issues WARN / HALT / RESET.
agent_model.output_contract_annotation: Structural interpretation only; no semantic inference.
